# Noto Sans 2.015

The launcher's text font, built into the launcher's exe so it needs no file at run time. These
files come unchanged from the official release
[NotoSans-v2.015](https://github.com/notofonts/latin-greek-cyrillic/releases/tag/NotoSans-v2.015)
(the hinted `NotoSans-Regular.ttf` and `NotoSans-SemiBold.ttf`), under the SIL Open Font License
1.1 (see [OFL.txt](OFL.txt)).
